events.text:
Sam, here are the 17 products with no sales in the last 90 days (as of 2026-10-21):

- P-0102, P-0117, P-0230, P-0231, P-0388, P-0412, P-0415, P-0501, P-0577, P-0610, P-0644, P-0702, P-0719, P-0803, P-0815, P-0902, P-0990

**Issue from my last week's price change:** The catalog check flagged that 22 products on fixed-price customer contracts (P-1201 through P-1222) were increased 3% on 2026-10-14. They should have been excluded. That was my error. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the increased prices, for a total overcharge of 4,128.60.

I haven't changed any prices. Proposed next steps:
1. Revert P-1201 to P-1222 to their pre-increase prices. I can do this once Lena Ortiz or you confirm.
2. Decide how to handle the 8 affected orders, including whether customers are refunded or credited. That decision belongs to Lena or you.

I can also message Lena about the error if you'd like.
